title: Extraction architecture implementation & blind pre-certification
objective: Implement the asymmetric hybrid role extraction architecture (Layers 1-5), commit and lock the new independent evaluator (evaluator-batch06.ts), package primary and secondary blind validation corpora (>=50 roles, 15-20 resumes each) with blank annotation templates for external human adjudication and dual-review, pre-register thresholds and refined failure consequence semantics, and execute single-pass blind validation scoring on the Primary Set (Steps 1-5). Step 6 shadow mode deployment remains a deliberate checkpoint requiring governance approval.
mustNotChange: deterministic Extraction V1 semantics or frozen-baseline behavior until certified
production extraction authority remains the existing deterministic baseline until Batch 06 production certification
scripts/transition/evaluator-v2.ts and scripts/transition/evaluator-r2.ts are immutable historical evidence; Batch 06 must create a new evaluator artifact
the implementation agent must not author or adjudicate final reference truth; human truth boundary is mandatory
do not execute pipeline against primary set without both primary and secondary holdouts pre-frozen and hashed
no live shadow-mode execution or scraper mutation until Steps 1-5 are completed and approved
evaluation, policy, verdict, canonical persistence, dossier, serving, UI, or Batch 01 source/provenance immutability behavior
do not mutate historical Batch 04/04B/04C evidence under audit-reports/
requiredVerification: commit and SHA-256 lock new production evaluator (evaluator-batch06.ts) in Step 1
implement HighRiskSemanticVerifier and StructuralAdmissionEngine in Step 2
package source documents, ingest external human reference truth, dual-review, and hash lock both primary and secondary holdouts in Step 3
pre-register thresholds and refined failure consequence table in Step 4
execute single-pass blind validation on primary set and baseline dual-run in Step 5
npx tsc -p tsconfig.verify.json --noEmit after each implementation commit
per-commit acknowledgement in IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json for governed changes
npm run transition:check after acknowledgement and before agent completion
completionEvidence: Step 2 verifier and structural admission implementation
Step 3 primary and secondary blind population and reference truth hash freeze
agentCompletionRule: Every committed change touching a non-governance path must be acknowledged by exact commit SHA in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json before the agent may report completion. Uncommitted governed changes fail transition control. Tests are governed changes and require explicit authorization in allowedPathPrefixes. Update RADAR_TRANSITION_CONTROL.md itself only when gate/scope/decision/invariant/exit criteria change.
scopeChangeRule: If implementation requires a path or semantic owner outside this manifest, stop first. Amend the control record/state/batch scope explicitly.
